BillingArrangementLine.name: BillingArrangementLine
BillingArrangementLine.description: Represents the billing account, billing profile, and the percentage of billing amount to be invoiced. Each billing arrangement line results in a separate invoice addressed to the selected billing account.

AccountId.description: Required. The ID of the account that's related to the billing arrangement line.

BillingAccountId.description: Required. The ID of the billing account record that's related to the billing arrangement line.

BillingArrangementId.description: Required. The ID of the billing arrangement record that's related to the billing arrangement line.

BillingPercentage.description: Required. The percentage of the billing amount to be assigned to the billing account of the billing arrangement line.

ShouldBillRemainder.description: Indicates whether the remainder percentage must be billed to the billing account of the billing arrangement line (true) or not (false).

VersionNumber.description: A numerical value indicating the current version of the billing arrangement record. The version number increases when new billing arrangement line records are added or existing billing arrangement line records are updated.
